about: Store screenshot sets for Emojio: which raw capture goes in which store slot, in upload order, with its caption. Raw captures come from the simulator with the debug-only EMOJIO_DEMO hook (lib/store_demo.dart; see capture.sh). build.py frames and lints them. Captions follow the 2026-10 ASO pass.
